name: Del Paso Heights Bloods
description: The Del Paso Heights Bloods (DBHB), also known as the 909 DPH Bloods, are a large Blood umbrella gang operating since the 1980s in the Del Paso Heights neighborhood of North Sacramento, California. The organization comprises several subsets including the True Heights Villains, Elm Street Bloods, Trigger Mob Gang (TMG), Beast Mob, and Flat Dogs. Their rivals include the Nogales Gangster Crips, North Highlands Gangster Crips, Garden Blocc Crips, Oak Park Bloods, and the Strawberry Manor Gangster Bloods.
